name: caveman
description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
one_liner: A translator that makes your AI coding assistant talk in short, blunt sentences instead of flowery prose, so each request costs less.
buyer: A solo developer or small team paying per-token for an AI coding subscription who wants a lower monthly bill.
business_use_cases: An indie hacker running dozens of daily AI coding sessions installs it to stretch a fixed monthly AI budget further.
A dev tooling vendor bundles it into a 'cost optimization' feature of their own AI product.
A bootcamp teaches it as a tip for students on free-tier AI coding plans.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'tune your agent for cost' setup service to freelancers on tight AI budgets.
Build a lightweight SaaS that tracks token savings across a team and reports monthly ROI.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple cost calculator landing page: 'see how much you'd save' based on a team's current AI coding spend, to drive installs and upsells.
